content: आगन्तुक {%a.%} (-का, -की|{%f.%}) .²1 Coming of oneʼs own accord, arriving uninvited; आगन्तुका वयम् <ls>Dhūrt.</ls> .²2 Stray (as an animal); <ls>Y. 2. 163</ls>. .²3 Incidental, accidental, adventitious; इत्यागन्तुका विकाराः {%<ls>Aśval.</ls>%} .²4 Interpolated, spurious (as a reading), having crept in without authority; अगन्धवद्गन्धमादनमित्यागन्तुकः पाठः <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 6. 46</ls>.
